Features , Benefits and Advantages
MAB : Rs. 25000/-
Free Monthly Cash Deposit limit : Free Cash Deposit- NIL Card rates will be applicable for cash deposit. Currently: ₹0.75 per ₹1,000/- + GST Minimum ₹50/- + GST Maximum ₹20,000/- + GST
Maximum Cash Deposit Limit at Non- Home Branch : Rs. 2 Lakhs per day
Cheque Book facility : Not allowed
Mode of Collection : Cash, Cheque, Draft RTGS, NEFT, IMPS, Payment Gateway etc.
Collection through Insta Deposit Card : Allowed
ATM : Not allowed
INB : View rights only
Payment of cash : Not allowed
ECS Debit Mandate : Not allowed
Bulk Debit transactions : Not allowed
Issuance of DD/BC on customer request : Not allowed
Charges
Charges for Non-maintenance of Minimum MAB : Rs.500 + GST per month
Annual Account Keeping Applicable : As per card rate
SMS Alerts : As per card rate
All other Charges applicable : As per card rate
Statement of account on email Allowed Settlement of fund from Collection Current Account to Main Account:
Settlement of funds will be done through either End of Day sweep facility to Main Account or home branch will make RTGS/NEFT to main account.
General Guidelines
